placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
Clevedon's seafront gives families the freedom to walk a little, sit a little and turn back whenever they are ready. Views of the pier and the Bristol Channel make even a short outing feel like time away.

Our family idea: choose one landmark as your turning point and count the benches or boats along the way. Leave time for a drink or snack rather than setting a distance target for small children.

placepracticalinfo.heading: Practical information
placepracticalinfo.bestFor: Mixed-age families looking for an easy-going seaside visit.
placepracticalinfo.facilities: Seafront benches and nearby cafes; check public toilet availability before travelling.
placepracticalinfo.parking: Use signed seafront or town parking and check current tariffs.
placepracticalinfo.goodToKnow: Keep to the promenade for the gentler option; adjoining coast paths are more uneven. The walk is free, while pier admission and refreshments are separate.

placevisitmap.heading: Plan your visit
placevisitmap.address: Clevedon Pier end of the seafront, The Beach, Clevedon, BS21 7QU
placevisitmap.travelNote: Use signed seafront or town parking and check current tariffs. Use this postcode for the arrival area, then follow local signs to the entrance. Google Maps can use your current location, or you can enter a starting point.
